title: Templates
footer: A template is a set of configuration applied in one step: this browser's looks, the sidebar's pages, extensions and the assistant's settings. You see every change before it applies.
default_description: Persona as it comes: the top switch on phones, the full main chat, Agents and Settings, every optional feature on and the sidebar's pages in their default places.
import_hint: Paste a template link or its JSON to see what it changes.
from_link: This template came from a link. Check what it changes before you apply it.
scope_note: Sidebar pages, extensions and settings apply to every device that uses this hub; the other items apply to this browser only.
storage_failed: This browser did not save the change
look_settings_view_short: A few tabs, the rest under More
settings_unsupported_hub: This hub cannot apply settings from a template yet
setting_unsupported: Not a setting a template can change
setting_not_allowed: Change this one yourself in Settings
